640-1263-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-1263-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Dross Harvester and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4222-6723-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

2034-4289-5223-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1368-4289-4885-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-4885-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

924-3499-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-3499-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-3499-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-3499-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

997-1453--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

1978-3789-7434--148.notablePrerequisites:
There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
1978-3789-7434--148.description:
Animate Brass Infiniscope.
Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
1978-3789-7434--148.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

3259-4478-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora that doesn't have summoning sickness.
3259-4478-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-997-4294-7115.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 11.

141-2921-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

4294-5220-5686.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

628-997-2193.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

147-313-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-5686.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4985-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4985-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3781-4191-5147--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2034-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

428-1694-3769-3908.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-1694-3769-3908.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Spark Double.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Spark Double triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

225-3688-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-3688-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2103-2707-3786.notablePrerequisites: Ardent Dustspeaker does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2103-2707-3786.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Ardent Dustspeaker as an attacker.
Ardent Dustspeaker triggers, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard, then exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them this turn.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1409-1494-4802.notablePrerequisites:
Master Biomancer has power five or greater.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Sage of Hours.
1409-1494-4802.description:
Activate Sage of Hours by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
When Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing Deadeye Navigator and Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

442-575-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ainok Survivalist, adding {C}{C}.
Ainok Survivalist dies, triggering Yedora, returning Ainok Survivalist to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Activate Ainok Survivalist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ainok Survivalist's megamorph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ainok Survivalist triggers, destroying target artifact or enchantment an opponent controls.
Repeat.

624-3191-3890-4050-4600.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding {B}.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Unearth and up to one other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Kairi.
Repeat.

1561-1742-3245.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw cards equal to half your library size and lose half your life total, rounding up both times.
Activate Skirge Familar by discarding any card besides Exsanguinate, adding {B}.
Repeat step 2 for all applicable cards in your hand.
Cast Exsanguinate by paying all available black mana, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amound of mana paid minus two, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

343-2050-4222.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Forest.
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
You are the monarch.
343-2050-4222.description:
Activate a Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth's last ability triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping a Forest.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
